goal: Remove dead multi-passphrase handling logic from the wallet encryption system
Prevent inconsistent wallet states and simplify key management for wallet maintainers
agreement: Broad agreement that keeping only one encryption key simplifies maintenance (rkrux, jeanpablojp)
Verified backward compatibility with nonstandard master key identifiers through testing (vicjuma)
Considered safe since corrupted edge-case wallets failing to load is acceptable (davidgumberg)
Concept approval with open questions on unloadable wallets and safety assertions (polespinasa)

why: P3 because it cleans up obsolete multi-passphrase design that was never implemented
Improves code maintainability by eliminating redundant loops without changing wallet features
